CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

2. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.
   C. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Journey to Jerusalem: to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Approaches to Work and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
